about: READ-ONLY: `systemctl list-units --all` for one unit-name glob (e.g. boss-*), plain and unpaged: every matching unit with its load/active/sub state and description. Added 2026-09-12 to enumerate the second BOSS stack on boss-gcp before anything is retired (45641c91 / d5941ef3 car 2: 'establish the dependency order BEFORE stopping anything') — the host has 23 cluster chores and a full older stack, and the tree can name only what it installed. The glob is one token of unit-name characters plus `*` and `?`; no spaces, no shell.
